_doc: corpus freshness tiers + fail multiplier (Soft-Hard Freshness Ladder). fail = tier x 1.5 (half-yearly 6mo -> 9mo, yearly 12mo -> 18mo; the 6/9 dead-man ladder is re-derived as 6x1.5). Freshness fact sources: judge-twins reads the reverify-ledger.json tail (single fact source); probes and mr-probes read max(collected_at) in the corpus itself (the refresh date seeds it); twins reads fresh_since here until a reverify channel exists (declared known-exposed, refreshed at the yearly cycle).
